items.title: Ed Polcer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I can put the stem in and you can sound like some of the Duke Ellington trumpet sections.

ctx.x: Is it a form of art for you?

Oh, jazz itself is a cause celebre. It is an art. And my motivation, it’s the reason I am on the face of the earth, is to play good jazz music, and doing all the things that I’m doing, promoting other players, promoting concerts, working for, I don’t anymore, but International Art of Jazz, doing stuff in schools, doing stuff in the public, carrying on The Magic of Swing Street out in Boise, Idaho and Cut Bank Shelby, Montana, you know in Cut Bank Shelby is one of the great Duke Ellington fans, a lady, a Native…
This concept of “The Magic of Swing Street,” when did it kind of come together for you?
